name: shapewall
description: Steer and build your app with your coding agent from a Shapewall board: the board's MCP tools plus skills that take a comment from request to recaptured, compared and answered.

interface.shortDescription: Steer and build your app from its board
interface.longDescription: Shapewall shows every screen of your app on one board. People pin comments to the screens; with this plugin your agent picks them up, changes the code, recaptures and compares the pages, and answers each comment.
defaultPrompt: Take the next open Shapewall comment
Finish the Shapewall comments I left today on the Features page
